plan.major: Communication Studies Associate in Arts Degree for Transfer 2.0
plan.notes: Official Fullerton College Program Pathways Mapper (fullcoll.programmapper.com), site-content year 2025-2026; pathway “to CSU - Part-Time map”. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total credits (61) = sum of published pathway slots. Per-course prerequisites are not published in structured form on the mapper, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. A prerequisite naming a course outside the published pathway would be listed in external_prereqs, never invented into a term. The official map also shows 3 advising milestone(s) (e.g. graduation-application reminders); these are not credit-bearing requirements and are not modeled as courses.

courses.title: Choose a course from Area 2.
courses.choice_note: Choose one course from the official map's “Choose a course from Area 2.” list (25 options). Recommended/first option: MATH 171 F. Map lists 3–6 units; encoded at lower bound. Map description: Choose a course from Area 2 that is either 3 semesters or 4 quarter units. Program requires at least one course.

courses.title: Choose a course from Area 6.
courses.choice_note: Choose one course from the official map's “Choose a course from Area 6.” list (10 options). Recommended/first option: ETHS 131 F. Map description: Choose a course from Area 6 that is either 3 semesters or 4 quarter units. This course must be in ethnic studies or in a similar field provided that the course is cross-listed with ethnic studies.
